info.title: Stream Estate API
info.description: The Stream Estate API is designed to enable builders to easily query, observe, and automate real estate data and insights. All API calls require the `X-API-KEY` header. Sign up at https://stream.estate/signup and create an API key in your settings.

tags.name: Properties
tags.description: Query aggregated real estate properties and their adverts.

tags.name: Indicators
tags.description: Market indicators, points of interest and location lookups.

tags.name: Searches
tags.description: Saved searches with webhook or email notifications.

get.description: Simulates a `match` or an `event` to the given endpoint. Your server implementation should return a `200` HTTP status code if the data was received successfully. If a webhook fails, it will be retried up to five times, each retry 1 hour after the previous one. Restricting your endpoints to the Stream Estate IP addresses is highly recommended: sandbox `178.238.226.136`, production `144.76.91.183`.

parameters.name: endpoint
parameters.description: Endpoint where the match or the event will be sent to.

parameters.name: eventType
parameters.description: The type of event you want to trigger.

200.description: The simulated payload was sent to the given endpoint.

400.description: Bad Request — your request is incorrect.

401.description: Unauthorized — your API key is wrong.

apiKey.name: X-API-KEY
apiKey.description: API key created in your Stream Estate settings.

AdvertEvent.description: A change recorded on an advert (price update, surface update, ...).

Advert.description: A published listing of the property on a source site.

feesResponsibility.description: Responsibility for fees. `0` for seller, `1` for buyer.

PropertyDocument.description: A real estate property aggregated from one or more adverts.

expired.description: A property is considered expired when all its adverts are expired.

propertyType.description: Apartment `0`, House `1`, Building `2`, Parking `3`, Office `4`, Land `5`, Shop `6`.

series.description: Price per meter time series keyed by period (e.g. `2023-01`).

LocationAutocompleteItem.description: A city or department matching the autocomplete query.

Search.description: A saved search with optional webhook / email notifications.

eventEndpoint.description: HTTPS webhook that receives advert `event` payloads.

expressions.description: Full text matching rules applied to the title or description.

propertyTypes.description: Apartment `0`, House `1`, Building `2`, Parking `3`, Office `4`, Land `5`, Shop `6`.

bedroomMin.description: Minimum number of bedrooms in the property.

bedroomMax.description: Maximum number of bedrooms in the property.

endpointRecipient.description: HTTPS webhook that receives `match` payloads whenever a property satisfies the search. Requires `notificationEnabled=true`.

eventEndpoint.description: HTTPS webhook that receives advert `event` payloads (price changes, expirations, etc.). Requires `notificationEnabled=true` and at least one entry in `subscribedEvents`.

expressions.description: Full text matching including/excluding words & phrases in the title or the description of the property.

furnished.description: Whether the property is furnished or not.

geoAccuracy.description: Geocoding confidence level. Use `1` to keep only house-number level matches and `2` to include neighborhood-level approximations. Leave empty to allow both.

geoShapes.description: Filters properties within specified geographic areas (arrays of `[lon, lat]` points forming polygons).

hidePropertyContact.description: Whether to hide property contact information or not.

includedCities.description: Included cities. Use the location autocomplete endpoint to get the desired city IRIs.

includedDepartments.description: Included departments. Use the location autocomplete endpoint to get the desired department IRIs.

includedZipcodesInsee.description: Included INSEE codes (used to infer the cities associated with the search).

lat.description: Latitude of the center point used for radial filtering. Provide together with `lon`.

lon.description: Longitude of the center point used for radial filtering. Provide together with `lat`.

notificationEnabled.description: Enables delivery of matches and events either by webhook (`endpointRecipient`, `eventEndpoint`) or by email (`notificationRecipient`).

notificationRecipient.description: Email address that receives alert summaries when `notificationEnabled=true`.

propertyTypes.description: Type of property. Apartment `0`, House `1`, Building `2`, Parking `3`, Office `4`, Land `5`, Shop `6`.

radius.description: Distance in kilometers around the provided `lat`/`lon`.

subscribedEvents.description: Event codes you want to receive on the `eventEndpoint`.

withCoherentPrice.description: Excludes adverts whose price has been flagged as incoherent/outlier by quality checks. Set to `false` to return every result regardless of price sanity.

withVirtualTour.description: Whether the property includes a virtual tour.
